package testdata

import "github.com/a-h/templ"

var unsafe = templ.Raw("<i>top</i>")

templ GoCode(s string) {
	@card.Card(card.Props{Class: "p-2"})
	@button.Button(button.Props{Attributes: templ.Attributes{"style": "x"}})
	{ templ.Raw(s) }
	<p :class="x">a</p>
	<p x-bind:style="y">b</p>
	<p x-show="open">c</p>
	@templ.Raw(s)
	{{ h := templ.FromGoHTML(nil, s) }}
	@button.Button(button.Props{Attributes: templ.Attributes{"hx-get": "/x"}})
}
